source_text: 过去，乘飞机出行对大多数中国人来说是难以想象的。如今，随着经济的发展和生活水平 的提高，越来越多的中国人包括许多农民和外出务工人员都能乘飞机出行。他们可以乘飞机 到达所有大城市，还有很多城市也在筹建机场。航空服务不断改进，而且经常会有廉价机票。 近年来，节假日期间选择乘飞机外出旅游的人数在不断增加。
reference_translation: In the past, it was unimaginable for most Chinese people to travel by plane. Nowadays, with the economic development and the improvement of living standards, more and more Chinese people, including many farmers and migrant workers, can travel by plane. They can fly to all big cities, and many other cities are also planning to build airports. The aviation service is constantly improving, and there are often cheap air tickets. In recent years, the number of people who choose to travel by plane during holidays has been increasing.
